title: AI Product Manager
description:
Crimson Education is the world’s leading college admissions consulting firm, with over 1,490 Ivy League offers and 2,410 to the US Top 15. We help ambitious students gain admission to the world’s top universities through expert-led guidance and proven, data-driven strategies. Crimson students are 7x more likely to get into the Ivy League than their peers. We were recently featured on the front page of the Wall Street Journal.  
  
Crimson is the only college admissions consultancy that brings together:

* Former Ivy League and Top 20 admissions officers to rigorously review and refine applications
* Professors and PhD teaching fellows from leading universities to guide students through original, independent research — with pathways to selective peer-reviewed publication or conference presentation
* Past ISEF winners and judges who coach students to compete for state, national, and international science fair awards
* Capstone project mentors who help students design and scale leadership initiatives with real-world impact, measurable outcomes, and credible external validation

We’re backed by leading VC firms, including Tiger Global, Heal Partners, IceHouse Ventures, and Movac, and recently closed a USD $40M Series D funding round at a USD $640M valuation. We now operate across 21 markets worldwide, including the US, Canada, UK, Singapore, Japan, Hong Kong, Australia, and New Zealand.

#### **The Role:**

We’re looking for a product manager who thinks in systems, not features. Our team — including product admins and student success managers — handles a large and growing workload, and much of it is still manual: watching customer Slack channels, cross-referencing Google Sheets, catching escalations late, onboarding our students etc. Your job is to design the product and infrastructure that takes that load off people so they can focus on the work that actually matters.  
  
You’ll own the full picture: how the dashboard and interface fit together, how information flows between systems, and where AI can quietly do the heavy lifting. The bar is simple — every feature you ship should make someone’s day easier, never add cognitive load.  
  
This is a hands-on role for someone who is product-minded with a real technical sense. Not a pure PM who hands off specs, and not a pure developer — someone who can talk to a user, sketch the flow in Figma, build a working prototype in Dify or n8n, and judge whether the result is genuinely good to use.

#### **What you’ll do**

* **Own the end-to-end experience.** Design the dashboard and interface as a coherent whole, not a collection of features. Understand how each screen, workflow, and data point connects, and keep the system simple as it grows.
* **Design for real users under real load.** Observe how team members work, find friction and repetitive effort, and design flows that streamline high-volume work. UX quality is a core deliverable, not a finishing touch.
* **Use AI to remove work, not create it.** Identify where LLMs, RAG, and automation can take tasks off people’s plates — triage, summarization, flagging, routing, follow-ups — and design those capabilities so they feel invisible and trustworthy.
* **Build a unified view of the customer journey.** Integrate conversations from customer Slack channels with our core applications and Google Sheets so the team sees one picture instead of many.
* **Make service proactive.** Build systems that automatically flag and triage customer escalations before they become critical, and that help student success managers identify at-risk clients and trigger timely, automated follow-ups.
* **Prototype and verify quickly.** Use Dify.AI to build LLM-powered prototypes, implement RAG, and iterate on prompts; use n8n to orchestrate automated workflows across third-party apps and APIs. Validate ideas with working prototypes before committing engineering time.
* **Lead AI product design.** Prompt engineering, model selection and configuration, interaction design for AI features, and an evaluation framework that tells us whether an AI feature is actually working.
* **Run on data.** Monitor product and AI-effect metrics, analyze user behavior, identify pain points, and drive continuous iteration.
* **Stay current.** Track developments in AI tooling (Dify, n8n, Coze, and others), analyze competitors, and bring what’s useful back into our product.
* **Shape the roadmap.** Contribute to short-term product planning and offer well-reasoned input on product strategy and technical direction.

#### **What we’re looking for**

* **2–5 years of product management experience**, including 1–3 years designing AI-powered products.
* **Strong UI/UX judgment.** You understand information architecture, interaction design, and how to design for people doing high-volume work. You can tell the difference between “has the feature” and “is pleasant to use,” and you care about the difference. Proficient with Figma, Axure, or similar.
* **Solid AI product fundamentals.** Deep understanding of how LLM applications work; practical experience with prompt engineering and RAG; able to independently design, evaluate, and optimize an AI feature and balance technical feasibility against user experience.
* **Hands-on with AI tooling.** Real-world experience with Dify.AI, n8n, or comparable platforms — you build, not just specify.
* **Technical fluency.** Comfortable working closely with engineering and AI teams, understanding the principles and limitations of the technology, and helping get solutions shipped.
* **Systems thinking.** You see how pieces connect and design for the whole, not the part in front of you.
* **Exceptional communication.** Much of this role is talking to people, understanding their core needs, and finding a solution that works for everyone. Fluent English (spoken and written) and a talent for making complex things simple.
* **Independent drive.** Disciplined, self-motivated, and able to deliver high-quality work in a remote environment without micromanagement. Strong sense of ownership.

#### **Why work for Crimson?**

* Rapidly growing start up, with a flexible working environment where you will be empowered to structure how you work
* Limitless development and exposure - our internal promotions/role changes made up 33% of all recruitment last year
* $1000 individual training budget per year, we love to ‘Level Up’ (it’s one of our core values)!
* Psychologist on staff
* Insightful fireside chats and workshops to help support our high-performing and ambitious team
* Radical Candor is a feedback approach we live by
* We’re a global player with 28 markets (and growing) across the globe. Most roles have the option to work from one of our many offices or remotely!

If you're passionate about growing in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and want to work with cutting-edge technology, then we'd love to hear from you!  
  
Please keep an eye on your spam/junk email folder for correspondence from Team Tailor.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**About the Role**

We're looking for an Associate Product Manager with 1–2 years of experience who is excited about building user-focused products and solving real customer problems. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and Business teams to take ideas from discovery to execution and continuously improve the product experience.

This role is ideal for someone who is analytical, curious, highly execution-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

Location: Vasant Kunj, Delhi - Hybrid

**What you'll do**

*Understand the problem*

* Talk to users regularly. Run interviews, sit in on support and sales calls, watch people use the product, and read the feedback nobody else reads.
* Separate what users ask for from what they actually need, and turn scattered input into a clear, prioritized problem list.
* Bring evidence, not opinions. Every proposal should trace back to something a real user said or did.

*Build and design*

* Turn ideas into clickable prototypes using AI tools like Claude, Lovable, or whatever gets you to a real interaction fastest, so users, stakeholders, engineers, and QA can all experience the thing before it's built.
* Design the experience end to end: the main flow, the empty states, the error messages, the edge cases.
* Use AI to multiply your output. Synthesizing research, building internal tools, analyzing data, testing ideas in an afternoon instead of a sprint.
* Help ship AI-powered features, and think hard about what happens when the model gets it wrong.

*Own delivery*

* Keep a clear, prioritized backlog for your area. Be able to explain why something is next, including what you're not doing and why.
* Write short and plainly: the problem, the user, one success metric, what's in scope and what isn't.
* Work with engineering and QA through backlog grooming, sprint planning, and QA. Answer questions, resolve ambiguity, test the release yourself before it ships.
* Help plan and run launches with the people who need to know: support, sales, marketing, and leadership.

**What we're looking for**

* **A portfolio we can open:** Projects, tools, prototypes, or products you've built.
* **User curiosity:** You open an app and can't help asking why people keep coming back to it, and what you'd steal.
* **AI fluency:** You've gone past basic prompting. You know how to give a model the right context, you've seen where models fail, and you've thought about what to do about it.
* **Taste:** Shown two versions of a screen, you can say which is better and explain why in terms of the user. You notice layout, hierarchy, spacing, and what a screen does when it's empty or broken.
* **Comfort with data:** You can pull numbers out of a sheet or a dashboard, spot when something looks off, and back a conclusion with them.
* **Clear thinking under ambiguity:** You can break a vague problem into something testable.
* **Strong communication:** You can explain a decision to an engineer, a designer, and a business stakeholder without changing the substance.
* **Attention to detail:** In the product, and in your own work.

**Nice to have**

* You've written an eval, or tuned LLM model settings and can say what changed.
* Fluency in Figma, or formal design training.
* Hands-on time with an analytics tool (Mixpanel, Amplitude, Metabase, GA).
* A side project with real users you didn't have to recruit.
* Interest in education, careers, or working with students.

No MBA required. No prior PM title required. If you're short on experience, product depth and the drive to build make up for it. What matters is what you've built.

description:

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Role Overview**
=================

We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own and investment products with a strong focus on Mutual Funds. The role will drive product strategy, roadmap, customer journeys, integrations and business outcomes across mobile and web platforms. The ideal candidate will have hands-on product management experience in a digital investment platform, wealth-tech company, fintech, bank or broking environment, and a strong understanding of the mutual fund investment lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**1. Mutual Fund Product Ownership**
------------------------------------

* Own the end-to-end mutual fund product lifecycle across discovery, investment, servicing and portfolio management.
* Drive digital journeys for onboarding, KYC, risk profiling, lumpsum investments, SIP registration, mandate setup, purchase, redemption, switch, cancellation, SIP pause/modify and transaction tracking.
* Build and enhance fund discovery, scheme details, comparison, filters, portfolio views, performance analytics, goal-based investing and investor education features.
* Work on integrations with AMCs, RTAs, BSE StAR MF / relevant transaction platforms, payment gateways, banks and other ecosystem partners, as applicable.
* Improve funnel conversion, transaction success, SIP activation, repeat investments, AUM growth and customer retention.
* Ensure a seamless experience across direct and regular mutual fund propositions, where applicable.

**2. Digital Product Strategy & Execution**
-------------------------------------------

* Define product vision, strategy, roadmap, prioritisation and success metrics in line with business objectives and customer needs.
* Translate business requirements into BRDs, product requirement documents, user stories, use cases, process flows and acceptance criteria.
* Drive product discovery through customer insights, data analysis, market research and competitor benchmarking.
* Partner with UX/UI, engineering, QA, operations, compliance and business teams to deliver scalable and intuitive digital experiences.
* Lead sprint planning, backlog prioritisation, UAT, release management and post-launch monitoring.

**3. Wealth & Investment Products**
-----------------------------------

* Work across adjacent investment products such as equities, ETFs, fixed deposits, bonds, NCDs, NPS, digital gold, PMS and AIFs, based on business priorities.
* Identify opportunities to create integrated investment journeys, cross-sell relevant products and improve customer lifetime value.
* Collaborate with AMCs, banks, brokers, fintech partners and vendors for product launches and platform integrations.

**4. Analytics & Business Growth**
----------------------------------

* Define and track KPIs including visitor-to-investor conversion, KYC completion, SIP registrations, mandate success, order success, AUM, active investors and repeat transaction rates.
* Analyse customer behaviour, funnel drop-offs, cohorts and product usage to identify growth and experience improvements.
* Use experimentation, A/B testing and data-led prioritisation to optimise product journeys.
* Prepare product performance dashboards and business reviews for senior stakeholders.

**5. Regulatory, Risk & Compliance**
------------------------------------

* Work with compliance, legal and operations teams to translate applicable SEBI, AMFI, AMCs, RTA and other regulatory requirements into product features and controls.
* Ensure appropriate disclosures, risk profiling, suitability, consent, audit trails and transaction controls are incorporated into customer journeys.
* Support regulatory change implementation, issue resolution and applicable reporting requirements.

**Required Experience & Skills**
================================

* 10–14 years of overall experience, with substantial hands-on product management experience in mutual funds or digital investment platforms.
* Strong understanding of the mutual fund lifecycle, including onboarding/KYC, fund discovery, purchase, SIP, mandates, redemption, switch, portfolio tracking and servicing.
* Experience owning digital products on mobile apps and/or web platforms, preferably in a high-volume consumer fintech or wealth-tech environment.
* Ability to define product strategy, write clear requirements, prioritise roadmaps and deliver measurable business outcomes.
* Experience working with engineering, design, QA, operations, compliance, business teams and external technology partners.
* Strong product analytics, funnel analysis, problem-solving, stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Working knowledge of APIs, payment flows, integrations, Agile delivery and UAT.

**Preferred Company Background**
================================

Candidates from digital investment, wealth-tech, fintech, discount broking and online mutual fund platforms will be strongly preferred. Relevant target organisations may include:

* Groww
* Zerodha (especially Coin / mutual fund product teams)
* ET Money
* INDmoney
* Kuvera
* Paytm Money
* Upstox
* Angel One
* FundsIndia
* Scripbox
* Other comparable digital wealth or mutual fund investment platforms.

Important: Prior experience in one of the above companies is a sourcing preference, not a substitute for relevant product ownership. Candidates must have directly worked on mutual fund product features, journeys or platform enhancements. Experience limited to sales, relationship management, distribution or back-office operations without digital product ownership would not be sufficient for this role.

**Educational Qualifications**
==============================

* MBA / PGDM / MFM or postgraduate qualification in Finance, Management, Technology or a related discipline preferred.
* NISM or other relevant capital markets / mutual fund certifications will be an advantage.

**Key Performance Indicators**
==============================

* Growth in mutual fund investors, AUM and SIP registrations.
* Improvement in onboarding, KYC, mandate and transaction conversion rates.
* Order success rate, journey completion and reduction in customer drop-offs.
* Feature adoption, active usage, repeat investments and customer retention.
* On-time delivery of roadmap commitments and quality of product releases.
* Regulatory readiness and timely implementation of compliance requirements.

description:
This is a growth-stage product operator role, not a 0-to-1 role. Webnyay has a mature product, established enterprise customers, live deployments, and meaningful transaction volumes across dispute resolution and grievance redressal.

Our platform powers complex workflows across arbitration, mediation, online dispute resolution, and BFSI grievance management. The product is live, the customers are real, and the operational challenges are substantial.

Your job is to grow it — through better, faster, and more scalable versions of what works, while building new capabilities that expand what our customers can do with Webnyay.

You should be comfortable working with complex workflows, demanding enterprise customers, and engineering teams. You should be equally comfortable understanding a legal or operational problem, translating it into a product requirement, and driving it all the way to deployment.

You'll Own

* **Product roadmap:** Owning and driving the roadmap across Webnyay's ODR, arbitration, mediation, BFSI dispute resolution, and grievance redressal products.
* **New feature development:** Identifying high-leverage opportunities from customer feedback, operational bottlenecks, and market requirements. Scoping and shipping capabilities that improve product value and expand our addressable market.
* **Backlog prioritisation:** Turning hundreds of customer requests, change requests, bug reports, and internal ideas into a coherent, prioritised shipping plan. Knowing what to build, what to defer, and what to push back on.
* **Enterprise workflow optimisation:** Understanding end-to-end dispute resolution workflows — from case initiation, notice generation and service, document management, hearings and arbitrator workflows to award generation, closure, billing, and reporting — and continuously improving them.
* **Customer-facing product management:** Working directly with customers, understanding their requirements, managing expectations, communicating feature releases, and handling difficult conversations around timelines, scope, and prioritisation.
* **Product documentation:** Writing clear PRDs, functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and release notes that engineering and implementation teams can execute against.
* **Cross-functional execution:** Working closely with engineering leads, design, legal operations, implementation, business development, and customer success to take features from requirement to production.
* **Product analytics:** Using product usage, operational metrics, customer feedback, and workflow data to identify friction, measure adoption, and make informed product decisions.
* **Competitive positioning:** Tracking the legal-tech, ODR, BFSI technology, and enterprise SaaS landscape to identify product gaps, emerging capabilities, and opportunities to differentiate Webnyay.

You'll work directly with the leadership team and have significant ownership over product decisions and execution.

How We Work: AI-Native by Default

This is important enough to call out clearly: **we expect our Product Managers to use AI across the entire product lifecycle.** AI is not a separate workstream or an occasional productivity tool. It should be embedded in how you research, think, design, document, build, and ship.

That Means

* **Discovery:** Synthesising customer interviews, analysing support tickets and change requests at scale, researching legal and regulatory requirements, and gathering competitive intelligence using AI tools.
* **Definition:** Drafting PRDs, generating user stories, mapping workflows, identifying dependencies, and stress-testing edge cases before handing requirements to engineering.
* **Design:** Creating wireframes, prototyping interfaces, exploring UI variants, and validating user flows using tools such as Figma AI, v0, Lovable, or Claude.
* **Build:** Translating requirements into technical specifications, understanding APIs and system architecture, debugging alongside engineers, and using AI to review code and understand implementation trade-offs.
* **Launch:** Generating release notes, preparing customer communications, creating product documentation, and enabling sales and implementation teams with feature updates.
* **Measure:** Querying product data, analysing adoption and turnaround times, identifying workflow bottlenecks, generating hypotheses, and using AI to accelerate product analysis.
* **Automate:** Identifying repetitive workflows across product, operations, and customer delivery that can be simplified or automated using AI agents and integrations.

We don't expect you to be an engineer. We do expect you to be technically curious, resourceful, and capable of using modern AI tools to move faster and produce better work.

What We're Looking For

* 3–6 years of experience in product management, preferably in B2B SaaS, enterprise software, fintech, legal-tech, or workflow automation.
* Experience owning an existing product and driving its roadmap, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Strong ability to translate ambiguous business and customer requirements into structured product specifications.
* Experience working with engineering teams and understanding technical trade-offs, APIs, integrations, and software architecture.
* Excellent written communication. You should be able to write a clear PRD, explain a complex workflow, and communicate a product decision without ambiguity.
* Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with data to prioritise opportunities and evaluate outcomes.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and demanding enterprise customers without losing sight of the product roadmap.
* A bias towards execution. You should be someone who takes ownership, follows through, and gets things shipped.
* Genuine interest in AI tools and a willingness to experiment with them as part of your everyday workflow.

**An added advantage:** Experience with legal workflows, arbitration, mediation, BFSI, lending, collections, grievance redressal, regulatory technology, or high-volume transaction platforms.

Pay: ₹700,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Work from home

title: Staff Product Manager, Time & Attendance
description:
**Overview**
------------

**Overview**

Small businesses drive the global economy. In the US, SMBs employ 60% of the labor force and create 80% of new jobs. However, the stakes are high, as 1 in 2 businesses will fail to survive within their first five years. In an environment where time is money, precise time tracking for payroll, invoicing, and project management is the critical lever for maintaining profitability and growing the business.

Within QuickBooks, our Workforce platform fuels productivity for growing teams — from time tracking and scheduling to project management and field operations. With 30M+ employees in the QuickBooks ecosystem and 18M paid through Workforce Solutions, we are building the essential tools that empower frontline teams and help businesses turn time into money.

**Opportunity**

We are seeking a Staff Product Manager to lead the verticalization of QuickBooks Time. You’ll make our time tracking platform the system of record for hours, labor cost, and payroll in the industries where labor is the highest cost, starting with construction and field services. Time is the source of hours for the entire QuickBooks ecosystem. Customers use the hours their teams track to run payroll, bill for their work, and understand whether each job is making money, and the mid-market businesses we serve need all three to work together without spreadsheets or re-entry.

This is a high-ownership role. You will own three connected areas end to end: time to payroll, so approved hours, overtime, and pay items flow into QuickBooks Payroll accurately and automagically; job costing, so every hour tracked produces labor cost estimates against projects and budgets before payroll runs and accurate actuals after it; and worker time tracking across Workforce Web, Workforce Kiosk, and the Workforce mobile app, where millions of workers track their time. You will build on Time 2.0, our rebuilt time platform that now lives inside QuickBooks Online, and extend it so that serving a new industry is mostly configuration rather than new code.

We need a scrappy, customer-obsessed product leader who leads through influence. Someone who navigates dependencies across Payroll, Projects, Mid-Market, and Payments, earns the trust and confidence of our customers and accountants, and ships experiences that delight both the worker clocking in on a job site and the admin who approves time and runs payroll.

**Responsibilities**

**Responsibilities**

* **Vertical Strategy.** Own the multi-year roadmap for verticalizing QuickBooks Time, starting with construction and field services. Translate how each industry runs its labor (jobs, cost codes, phases, and certified payroll on a construction site; jobs, visits, and dispatch in field services) into shared platform concepts and configurable experiences, so that each new vertical is mostly configuration rather than new code. Decide what we build, what we configure, and where partner integrations fill the gap.
* **Time to Payroll.** Own the flow of hours from clock-in to paycheck. Make approved time, overtime and break policies, and pay items land in QuickBooks Payroll accurately and automatically, with no exports, syncs, or re-entry, and make approvals fast and trustworthy for a mid-market company with hundreds of employees.
* **Job Costing: Estimates and Actuals.** Deliver real-time labor costing that owners, project managers, and accountants trust. Partner with Projects, Payroll, and Accounting so that time is the single source of hours for payroll, invoicing, and profitability reporting.
* **Worker Time Tracking.** Own how workers track time across Workforce Web, Workforce Kiosk, and the Workforce mobile app, where millions of workers already track their hours. Deliver one consistent, reliable experience for clocking in and out, breaks, schedules, geofencing, and job and task selection that holds up on a job site with poor connectivity and for crews whose first language is not English, and complete the migration of workers off legacy TSheets surfaces onto the new platform.
* **Commercial Impact.** Own the metrics for your area: Time adoption within Workforce Premium and Elite offerings, attached in mid-market and industry editions. Plus worker engagement across web, kiosk, and mobile. Use data and customer evidence to prioritize, measure what ships, and make Time and real-time job costing a central part of how QuickBooks is sold to construction and field services customers, a market where competitors generate $150M+ ARR.
* **Operational Velocity.** Run the end-to-end product lifecycle for your area: write crisp requirements, pressure-test designs, manage edge cases, and drive alignment across engineering, design, data, go-to-market, and customer success teams in the US and India. You lead through influence rather than authority, and you are fluent in AI-native tools like Claude and Cursor, using them to move faster from insight to shipped product.
* **Customer Empathy.** Be the voice of the business owner, the payroll admin, and the frontline worker. Spend time with customers on their job sites and with the accountants who recommend HCM products to their clients, and make sure every feature removes a real pain point in how they bid, schedule, track, pay, and get paid.

**Qualifications**

description:
Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need. Learn more at Astellas.com (https://www.astellas.com/en)
  
Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?
  
We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact.

**Purpose and Scope:**

The R&D Domain Data Product Manager develops recommendations for and activates the approved data product strategy for an assigned biopharma R&D domain. Working with the Data Domain Owner and scientific, clinical, data, architecture, governance, engineering and platform stakeholders, the role identifies high-value user and business needs and translates them into a coherent portfolio of reusable data products. It establishes proposed product boundaries, value hypotheses and roadmaps, incorporates quality and governance expectations defined with data stewards and relevant specialists, and recommends investment priorities for approval by the Data Domain Owner.
  
The role owns domain-level product discovery, portfolio prioritization recommendations, product mobilization and cross-product dependency management within approved priorities and investment guardrails. It coordinates validation of scientific relevance and consumer needs with scientific and clinical stakeholders; technical feasibility and interoperability with architecture, modeling, engineering and platform teams; and quality, governance, privacy and analytical and AI-use readiness with data stewards, governance specialists and relevant privacy and technical authorities. Once a product is approved and sufficiently defined, detailed delivery and lifecycle accountability transitions to a designated Data Product Owner. The Domain Data Product Manager retains responsibility for domain-wide portfolio coherence, cross-product dependencies, portfolio-level value tracking, identification of reuse opportunities and alignment with the approved domain strategy.

**Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**

* Partner with the Data Domain Owner to translate domain outcomes, use cases, investment priorities, and OKRs into a clear domain data product vision, roadmap, and strategic backlog.
* Establish and continuously refine a prioritized domain backlog covering candidate data products, domain blueprint work, source dependencies, data contracts, governance needs, and enabling platform capabilities.
* Work with the Domain Data Architect and Domain Data Modelers to develop and maintain the domain blueprint, product decomposition, canonical/semantic modeling priorities, interoperability needs, and reusable architecture patterns.
* Facilitate use-case decomposition into required data products, MVP boundaries, capabilities, sequencing, business value hypotheses, and measurable success criteria.
* Coordinate demand intake, opportunity evaluation, value/effort prioritization, dependency mapping, and escalation of cross-domain or platform constraints; make trade-offs transparent to the Domain Owner.
* Maintain a consolidated view of domain initiatives, product status, backlog readiness, delivery milestones, capacity assumptions, risks, decisions, and strategic dependencies.
* Engage the Foundation Data Platform team to align on source availability, ingestion needs, technical readiness, shared standards, and planned capability changes without taking ownership of platform engineering.
* Partner with Data Governance Specialists and stewards to embed ownership, business glossary, metadata, data quality, lineage, contract, certification, privacy, and AI-readiness expectations into domain planning.
* Define product initiation and handoff criteria; identify and onboard the accountable Data Product Owner before detailed product delivery begins.
* Transition each approved product's delivery backlog, acceptance criteria, releases, consumer engagement, adoption, and ongoing lifecycle management to its Data Product Owner; provide portfolio-level coordination thereafter.
* Facilitate domain planning, backlog refinement, roadmap reviews and cross-team dependency forums with Core and Value Teams.

* Monitor domain-level business value, roadmap progress, adoption, reuse, and bottlenecks; recommend adjustments and improvements to the operating model and ways of working.
* Support cross-domain alignment and portfolio scaling while preserving the Data Domain Owner's authority over outcomes, investments, and major prioritization decisions.
* When required, provide Business Analyst (BA) support during discovery and mobilization by eliciting user needs, analyzing business processes, and developing requirements, user stories and initial acceptance criteria with stakeholders and the designated Data Product Owner.

  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or master’s degree in information systems, Data Science, Computer Science, Life Sciences, or a related discipline.

* Experience facilitating prioritization, managing cross-team dependencies, and coordinating stakeholders across business, architecture, governance, platform, and engineering teams.

* Working knowledge of scientific and regulated-data principles, including provenance, traceability, FAIR practices, privacy by design and, where applicable, GxP and ALCOA+ expectations.
* Strong facilitation, communication, executive storytelling, negotiation, and Agile/product delivery skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

This is a domain-led, business-facing role grounded in production reality rather than abstract requirements. You'll work alongside real users, real workflows, and real data, on engagements that are scoped, time-boxed, and exit-oriented—leaving behind documented domain artifacts and reusable patterns so that each deployment makes the next one materially faster.

The role draws on healthcare breadth rather than a single specialty, spanning provider and payer domains—from revenue cycle, utilization management, and clinical operations to network strategy, risk adjustment, actuarial, and beyond.

**About Tekion:**
-----------------

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

**Job Introduction**

Tekion is expanding its platform into security and compliance products for automotive retail, and we are hiring a senior product professional to own this new product area end to end. This role will build across two connected domains:

* **Compliance / GRC:** Products that help dealerships meet regulatory obligations, including F&I deal compliance, privacy and data governance, and evolving federal and state requirements, directly within the systems they already use.

* **Cybersecurity:** A modular suite of security capabilities delivered as independent products over time, including vulnerability and network scanning, continuous exposure management, endpoint detection and response, email security, credential-exposure monitoring, data-loss prevention, and log analytics / SIEM.

This is both a zero-to-one and scaling mandate. The role will define strategy, roadmap, packaging, pricing, and go-to-market approach, turning validated customer demand into shippable, monetizable products. The role requires close collaboration with US-based stakeholders and customers, including periodic time-zone overlap.

What You’ll Own

* Product strategy for Tekion’s security and compliance product lines, including the vision, boundaries, and how the two domains reinforce one another.

* Roadmaps for both domains, including sequencing of a modular, SKU-based product portfolio and defining the scope of each release.

* Packaging and pricing models, including subscriptions, consumption-based models, entitlements, and bundling.

* Voice of customer through continuous discovery with dealerships and dealer groups to validate demand before build.

* Cross-functional delivery in partnership with engineering, design, GTM, legal/compliance, security, and platform teams.

Key Responsibilities

Product Development & Strategy

* Own the holistic vision, roadmap, strategy, and launch plan for Automotive Security Cloud across security and compliance workstreams.

* Conduct market and competitive research to identify customer needs, product opportunities, market size, and differentiation.

* Define product positioning, messaging, and business rationale for new security and compliance offerings.

* Build alignment across product, engineering, security, compliance, GTM, legal, and leadership stakeholders.

Requirements & Analysis

* Run continuous customer discovery and translate findings into prioritized, well-specified product requirements.

* Write clear PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and launch requirements; partner with engineering on scope, sequencing, and trade-offs.

* Track relevant regulatory requirements, including GLBA Safeguards, FTC rules, CCPA/CPRA, and GDPR, and translate obligations into product capabilities.

* Assess feasibility, risks, dependencies, costs, infrastructure needs, and resource requirements for proposed capabilities.

Go-to-Market & Commercialization

* Define the product/SKU catalog, entitlements, packaging, and pricing models for individual offerings and bundles.

* Build business cases and revenue models for new products, including subscription, usage-based, or modular SKU approaches.

* Recruit and manage design partners, run pilots, and convert validated pilots into referenceable customers and GA launches.

* Represent the product area to executives, sales, customers, and partners; support enablement, launch planning, and market entry.

* Define success metrics such as adoption, attach rate, retention, revenue, and risk reduction, and ensure products are instrumented to measure outcomes.

Cross-Functional Leadership

* Lead collaboration across technical teams working on areas such as email security, vulnerability management, continuous testing, detection, compliance, and platform integration.

* Maintain alignment with leadership stakeholders on product progress, roadmap decisions, customer feedback, and market dynamics.

* Make independent product decisions with strong ownership, accountability, and clear communication.

* Set and communicate a multi-quarter vision and roadmap with measurable outcomes.

Must-Have Qualifications

* 7+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years owning security, compliance/GRC, infrastructure, platform, or B2B SaaS products.

* Strong product management fundamentals, including discovery, roadmap definition, prioritization, stakeholder alignment, and translating business goals into executable requirements.

* Domain knowledge in at least one of the following: US automotive retail, dealership operations, F&I, DMS/CRM ecosystems, cybersecurity, GRC/privacy tooling, SIEM, EDR/XDR, vulnerability/exposure management, or DLP.

* Demonstrated experience taking a zero-to-one product to market or scaling an existing product line.

* Working knowledge of security architectures, threat models, security controls, and relevant compliance frameworks.

* Experience with subscription, usage-based, or modular SKU packaging and pricing for B2B SaaS products.

* Proven ability to work autonomously, make decisions independently, and drive products from concept through launch.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex technical, business, and regulatory requirements into clear product decisions.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical audiences.

* Comfortable working with US-based teams and customers, including periodic time-zone overlap.

Good-to-Have Qualifications

* Experience selling into or building products for regulated SMB or mid-market verticals.

* Familiarity with building on a platform or system of record such as DMS, CRM, or ERP.

* Experience productizing an internal capability into a customer-facing offering.

* Familiarity with ISO standards, SOC 2, dealership compliance, privacy regulations, and broader security governance needs.

* Hands-on exposure to security product categories such as vulnerability scanners, continuous penetration testing platforms, email security, threat detection, endpoint security, cloud security, or SIEM/log analytics.

description:
**Senior Product Manager - Search & Analytics Platform**

  

Sumo Logic is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the data, query, and context foundations that help customers and AI agents understand and act on operational and security telemetry.

Effective investigation depends on finding the right data, querying it efficiently, and understanding how it relates to the customer's environment. As AI agents take on more analytical work, they need dependable access to telemetry and context: which service an entity belongs to, what it depends on, who owns it, and what changed. This role owns the shared platform capabilities that make that possible across observability, security, and platform optimization.

You will own established search and analytics capabilities while building toward federated analytics and a richer customer context foundation. This is a technically deep role requiring first-hand experience with data platforms, search, or analytics products, and the judgment to turn a broad platform vision into useful capabilities that teams can adopt.

**What You Will Own**

**The search and query platform.** Search and query capabilities, query language and analytical functions, partitions, views, and shared query services. You will own their roadmap, performance, reliability, and competitiveness, balancing analytical depth, ease of use, and cost for both human and agent workloads.

**Federated analytics.** Define how customers and agents query and correlate Sumo data with data in connected systems. Establish the use cases, supported analytical capabilities, and tradeoffs around data movement, freshness, performance, permissions, and cost, working closely with the teams responsible for integrations and access.

**Customer context and the knowledge graph.** Build the shared understanding of a customer's environment: entities, services, workloads, ownership, topology, and dependencies. Define how that context is assembled from telemetry, metadata, and connected systems, how relationships are maintained, and how the accumulated context improves investigation and analysis over time.

**Data discovery and shared context services.** Help people and agents discover available sources, schemas, fields, and relationships, and retrieve the data and context relevant to a task. Own the shared capabilities that make this information reusable across product experiences, with clear provenance, freshness, and permission boundaries.

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Set the multi-quarter vision and roadmap for the data and analytics platform, connecting current customer needs with the requirements of AI-assisted investigation.
* Own the health and evolution of shipping query capabilities, partitions, and views, using customer feedback and workload data to prioritize improvements.
* Work with engineering and architecture on query execution, distributed analytics, scalability, and cost at enterprise scale.
* Define and validate federated analytics use cases, and turn them into phased capabilities with clear behavior and limits.
* Develop the entity and context strategy, including how services and resources are identified consistently across data sources and related to one another.
* Partner with investigation, security, knowledge, and agent teams to turn their needs into shared platform capabilities and clear interfaces.
* Partner with the product and engineering teams responsible for platform governance to ensure query and context capabilities respect established access controls, audit requirements, and cost policies.
* Translate strategy into clear proposals, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and rollout plans.
* Measure query success, latency, reliability, cost, context quality, and adoption, and show how platform improvements improve customer outcomes.

**What You Bring**

* 6+ years of product management experience, including direct ownership of data platforms, search, query systems, or analytics products. Relevant platform experience is a hard requirement.
* Strong technical understanding of query processing, data organization, indexing, schemas, and distributed systems, with depth in one or more of these areas.
* Experience running a live product at scale, balancing customer commitments, performance, reliability, and cost while delivering a longer-term roadmap.
* Experience building shared platform capabilities, APIs, or services used by multiple product teams or external developers.
* The ability to reason about analytical correctness, incomplete data, data freshness, and the limits of what a system can reliably infer.
* Familiarity with federated analytics, metadata platforms, entity resolution, knowledge graphs, or retrieval systems. Experience in one or more of these areas is valuable.
* An understanding of how AI agents discover data, use tools, and retrieve context, or the ability to ramp quickly. Observability or security analytics experience is a plus.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort using SQL, dashboards, and usage data to understand customer behavior and evaluate tradeoffs.
* Clear communication across technical and business audiences, and the ability to write proposals that explain options, dependencies, and recommendations.

**Must Have Qualities**

* **Platform judgment.** Finds common needs across teams and turns them into capabilities others can depend on.
* **Customer grounding.** Connects technical investment to a concrete improvement in analysis, investigation, or cost.
* **Data correctness and trust.** Treats accuracy, consistency, provenance, and freshness as product requirements.
* **Runs today and builds tomorrow.** Keeps current capabilities healthy while delivering the next generation of the platform.
* **High ownership.** Resolves ambiguity, makes tradeoffs explicit, and drives work through delivery and adoption.

**About Us**
------------

Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com.

Sumo Logic Privacy Policy. Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection.

description:
**Senior Product Manager**

**Response Automation (SIEM and SOAR)**

Sumo Logic is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the automation foundations that help security teams and AI agents turn detections into fast, safe, consistent response.

Finding a threat is half the job. Analysts still spend too much time enriching alerts, chasing context, opening tickets, and running containment steps by hand. As AI agents take on more of that work, response automation has to be dependable, auditable, and easy to control. This role owns the playbook, orchestration, and case management capabilities across Cloud SIEM and Cloud SOAR that make that possible.

You will own established automation capabilities while building toward agent-driven response and a tighter SIEM-to-SOAR experience. This is a technically deep role. It requires first-hand experience with security operations, SOAR, or workflow automation products, and the judgment to turn a broad platform vision into capabilities that SOC teams adopt and trust.

**What You Will Own**

**Playbooks and the automation engine.** The playbook editor, triggers, actions, execution engine, and the Automation Service. You will own their roadmap, performance, reliability, and competitiveness, balancing power, ease of use, and cost for analysts, detection engineers, and agents.

**Cloud SIEM and Cloud SOAR together.** Define how insights and signals in Cloud SIEM trigger automations and hand off to Cloud SOAR for incident and case management. Establish where the Automation Service ends and full Cloud SOAR begins, with clear packaging, upgrade paths, and one coherent customer experience.

**Integrations, actions, and App Central.** Set the strategy for enrichment, notification, containment, user choice, and custom actions. Prioritize integrations across endpoint, identity, cloud, ticketing, threat intelligence, and messaging tools. Own coverage, quality, and lifecycle for out-of-the-box playbooks and integrations.

**Agentic and human-in-the-loop response.** Define how AI agents discover, invoke, and chain playbooks and actions. Establish the approval steps, scoped permissions, guardrails, and audit trails that let customers decide which responses run automatically and which need an analyst's sign-off.

  

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Set the multi-quarter vision and roadmap for response automation, connecting current SOC needs with the requirements of AI-assisted investigation and response.
* Own the health and evolution of shipping playbook, automation, and case management capabilities, using customer feedback and execution data to prioritize improvements.
* Work with engineering and architecture on execution reliability, scalability, error handling, and cost at enterprise scale.
* Define and validate response use cases, such as phishing, compromised identity, and endpoint containment, and turn them into phased capabilities with clear behavior and limits.
* Develop the integration and action strategy, including how actions are named, scoped, versioned, and made safe to run without a person watching.
* Partner with detection, investigation, knowledge, and agent teams to turn their needs into shared automation capabilities and clear interfaces.
* Partner with the product and engineering teams responsible for platform governance to ensure automation respects established access controls, audit requirements, and cost policies.
* Translate strategy into clear proposals, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and rollout plans.
* Measure playbook success rate, time to respond, analyst time saved, reliability, cost, and adoption, and show how automation improvements lead to better security outcomes.

**What You Bring**

* 6+ years of product management experience, including direct ownership of security operations, SOAR, SIEM, or workflow automation products. Relevant platform experience is a hard requirement.
* Strong technical understanding of incident response workflows, orchestration engines, event-driven systems, APIs, and the integrations that connect security tools.
* Experience running a live product at scale, balancing customer commitments, reliability, and cost while delivering a longer-term roadmap.
* Experience building shared platform capabilities, APIs, or services used by multiple product teams, partners, or external developers.
* The ability to reason about automation risk, including false positives, partial failures, and the point where a human should approve an action.
* Familiarity with SOC operations and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and the NIST incident response lifecycle. Experience with case management, threat intelligence, or integration marketplaces is valuable.
* An understanding of how AI agents discover tools, take actions, and operate within guardrails, or the ability to ramp quickly. Hands-on SOC or security engineering experience is a plus.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort using SQL, dashboards, and usage data to understand customer behavior and evaluate tradeoffs.
* Clear communication across technical and business audiences, and the ability to write proposals that explain options, dependencies, and recommendations.

**Must Have Qualities**

* **Platform judgment.** Finds common needs across teams and turns them into capabilities others can depend on.
* **Customer grounding.** Connects technical investment to a concrete improvement in response time, analyst workload, or risk reduction.
* **Safety and trust.** Treats control, auditability, and predictable behavior as product requirements, especially when automation takes action on its own.
* **Runs today and builds tomorrow.** Keeps current capabilities healthy while delivering the next generation of the platform.
* **High ownership.** Resolves ambiguity, makes tradeoffs explicit, and drives work through delivery and adoption.

**About Us**
------------

Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com.
